Ugmuls 5.5e Automation · v0.7.5

Smoother casts.
Clearer results.

This release focuses on bug fixes and improvements: see what players are preparing, handle concentration checks, and keep targeting, dice, and shared spell areas moving together.

Pending casts & cancellation

See the plan.
Follow the action.

  • Show the cast sooner. A Pending card appears while a player chooses spell options, targets, Metamagic, or template placement, giving the GM a view of what is being prepared.
  • Cancel a misclick. Canceling before a roll removes the pending cast and refunds its spent resources and temporary action markers. Previous concentration stays until the new cast commits.
  • Keep the action visible. The initial attack card remains until its result appears, including during Dice So Nice animations, with duplicate attack clicks blocked during the handoff.
Concentration assistance

Take the hit.
Make the check.

  • Prompt the owner. Damage-triggered concentration checks go to a connected owning player, falling back to the GM. GM-run monsters follow the existing automatic NPC-save option.
  • Keep a pending check available. Canceling leaves the check available for retry or GM takeover. Disconnected owners fall back to the GM.
  • Let the dice finish. The outcome appears after active clients’ dice animations finish. Failed checks can automatically end the concentration recorded for that check while preserving newer spells.

Your choice: Prompt Concentration Checks and End Concentration on Failed Checks are separate options under Rolls & Damage / Healing.

Targeting & upcasting

The right targets.
The chosen spell level.

  • Catch missing targets. Direct attacks and targeted spells or features, including healing and marks, warn before use when no target is selected. Single-target uses also reject multiple selected targets.
  • Respect the upcast. Single-target checks use the spell’s scaled target count before spending resources. A spell that allows six creatures can still be cast on three; self and area spells keep their normal targeting flow.
  • Reach each willing recipient. Automatic buffs now recognize Willing Creature targets, fixing upcast Fly applying to the caster while skipping a selected friend.
Dice So Nice integration

Enjoy the dice.
Keep play moving.

  • Switch screens without holding up the roll. Animation waits release when a GM or player switches tabs, minimizes, or loses focus. Active clients still wait for their dice normally.
  • Clear finished saves. Grouped saving throws refresh after animation completes, fixing results that could remain Pending on multi-target spell cards.
  • Keep the rolled result. These changes improve the module’s Dice So Nice integration without changing the numerical dice results.
Shared spell areas

Empty at the cast.
Ready at the first trigger.

  • Prompt when the area first matters. An initially empty Spirit Guardians area prompts the caster for damage when its first eligible target triggers it, with GM fallback. Later targets reuse the shared roll.
  • Resolve the same Pending card. The regular Damage button now reuses an unresolved damage request instead of leaving a separate Pending card behind.
  • Keep arriving targets. Targets added while the damage dialog is open remain recorded when the result is published.

After updating: hard-refresh all connected GM and player browsers. This release was tested with Foundry VTT 14 and D&D5e 6.0.6.
